description: Search the product catalog. No API key. Each product has a title, a short and a longer description, pictures, a price, an offer when the list has one, and a url for the page where it can be bought. An empty products list means nothing matched. catalog_size 0 means the catalog is still loading.

limit.description: How many products to return. Default 6.

query.description: Product words, a brand, or a type. Example: wireless headphones.

name: search_products
title: Search the product catalog
